title: Primavera 150 Tech
description: The Vespa Primavera 150 Tech is crafted for effortless city navigation and exceptional fuel economy, positioned in the Commuter Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 150cc engine generating 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
